calcAddress(address,bytes).details: Uses same salt logic as deploy (but note calcSalt on pkg, not _calcSalt adaptor necessarily). Does not consume gas for deploy.      Matches the early-return path in deploy().

params.pkgArgs: The args (will be passed through pkg.calcSalt inside).

constructor.details: These facets are installed on *every* Diamond proxy deployed via this factory (see facetCuts).      The factory itself does not use storage Repos; uses immutables for facets + transient mappings (pkgOfAccount etc) only during init callback.      Matches IDiamondPackageCallBackFactoryInit.InitArgs.

params.init: Struct holding the four required immutable facet references (must be pre-deployed, non-zero).

deploy(address,bytes).custom:emits: IDiamond.DiamondCut (multiple times: base + package config + post-deploy removal)
deploy(address,bytes).custom:throws: DeploymentAddressMismatch if CREATE2 address math fails.
deploy(address,bytes).details: Flow (see IDiamondPackageCallBackFactory diagram):      1. Compute salt via pkg.calcSalt (via adaptor), then combine with pkg for unique salt.      2. Predict address; early return if already deployed.      3. processArgs, record (pkg, args) for the callback context (pkgConfig), call updatePkg.      4. CREATE2 the MinimalDiamondCallBackProxy (which delegatecalls factory.initAccount on construction).      5. Inside initAccount: install base facets + package's diamondConfig facets, call pkg._initAccount.      6. Call pkg.postDeploy and the hook removal.      This factory is intended to be deployed *once* per ecosystem and reused across chains/consumers.

params.pkg: The IDiamondFactoryPackage providing facets, cuts, init logic, and salt calc.
params.pkgArgs: Package-specific arguments (ABI encoded PkgArgs typically); not part of salt for recalc simplicity.

returns.proxy: The deterministic address of the deployed (or pre-existing) Diamond proxy.

erc8109Funcs().details: Helper to avoid hardcoding; used by facetCuts for the ERC8109Introspection facet.

facetCuts().details: Used in the base phase of initAccount before package config is applied. Corresponds to the facets from constructor InitArgs.

returns.facetCuts_: The base cuts used for the factory's contribution to proxy diamond config.

facetInterfaces().details: These are declared via ERC165 on the proxy during initAccount; enables external discovery of base capabilities.

initAccount().details: Resolves the pending (pkg, args) via pkgConfig (which uses msg.sender == the new proxy)      then delegates to the two-arg variant. Historical code paths are commented for reference.      This 0-arg version is the one the MinimalDiamondCallBackProxy actually delegatecalls during construction.

initAccount(address,bytes).custom:emits: IDiamond.DiamondCut (for base via SELF, and for package config)
initAccount(address,bytes).details: This is the two-arg variant called by the 0-arg callback after resolving pkgConfig.      It performs the actual ERC2535 cuts and interface registration + package _initAccount.

pkgConfig().details: Uses msg.sender to lookup the transient registration done in deploy(). Only valid during the init delegatecall window.      After postDeploy the mappings still hold the values (for off-chain query).

returns.pkg: The package for the caller proxy.

postDeploy(address).details: Removes the POST_DEPLOY_HOOK_FACET via a Remove cut. Virtual for overrides.      Called by the proxy itself via the hook facet (which delegates back).

postDeployFacetCuts().details: Virtual to allow potential overrides in subclasses. The remove uses the facet's funcs to clean all its selectors.

DIAMOND_LOUPE_FACET().notice: Immutable reference to the DiamondLoupe facet installed on every proxy by this factory.

ERC165_FACET().notice: Immutable reference to the ERC165 facet installed on every proxy by this factory.

ERC8109_INTROSPECTION_FACET().notice: Immutable reference to the ERC8109 introspection facet installed on every proxy.

POST_DEPLOY_HOOK_FACET().notice: Immutable reference to the post-deploy hook facet (temporarily installed, removed after init).

PROXY_INIT_HASH().notice: The initCode hash of the MinimalDiamondCallBackProxy used for CREATE2 address prediction.

calcAddress(address,bytes).notice: Predicts the deterministic proxy address for a pkg + pkgArgs without deploying.

constructor.notice: Constructs the factory wiring the required base facets (ERC165, Loupe, ERC8109, PostDeployHook).

deploy(address,bytes).notice: Deploys (or returns existing) a Diamond proxy instance for the given DFPkg + args.

erc8109Funcs().notice: Returns the single function selector from the ERC8109 facet used in base cuts.

facetCuts().notice: Returns the 4 base facet cuts (Add) applied to every new proxy during initAccount (ERC165, Loupe, ERC8109, PostHook).

facetInterfaces().notice: Returns the base interfaces installed by this factory on all proxies (ERC165 + Loupe + ERC8109).

initAccount().notice: Callback entrypoint invoked by the proxy constructor (via delegatecall).

initAccount(address,bytes).notice: Core initialization logic (can also be called directly in tests).         Applies factory base cuts, package config cuts, registers interfaces, invokes package init.

pkgArgsOfAccount(address).notice: Returns the (processed) package args associated with a deployed proxy account.

pkgConfig().notice: Called by the proxy (during its init callback) to retrieve the package/args for *this* deployment.

pkgOfAccount(address).notice: Returns the package that was used to deploy (or is deploying) the given proxy account.

postDeploy(address).notice: Post deploy hook invoked on the proxy (after package postDeploy) to clean up the temp hook facet.

postDeployFacetCuts().notice: Returns the cut used to remove the temporary post-deploy hook facet after init.
